about_the_game:
Claritas RPG - Extra Hero Pack 4


Unlock four powerful new heroes and expand your strategic options in battle! Each hero brings unique abilities and playstyles to enhance your party in new and exciting ways.

Renegade Knight

The former leader of the Black Knights, he broke the millennial tradition of committing suicide after his wife died. He instead chose exile and now wanders the world, searching for a new purpose.

Attributes:
Strength: 60 + 6 per Level
Intelligence: 30 + 3 per Level
Dexterity: 30 + 3 per Level

Skills:
Bewitched Blade: Magical sword that can deal slash or arcane damage.
Soul Strike: Passively causes every third hit to deal extra arcane damage.
Reaving Slash: Strikes all enemies and steals their attributes.
Death Mark: Marks an enemy for death, causing them to take damage after 5 turns.

Fairy Queen

Revered as a goddess by farmers, the Queen commands the cycles of the seasons, her will shaping bountiful harvests or barren fields. In gratitude, villagers offer a tithe of their finest produce, a sacred tribute to honor her dominion over nature's rhythm.

Attributes:
Strength: 20 + 2 per Level
Intelligence: 60 + 6 per Level
Dexterity: 40 + 4 per Level

Skills:
Fairy Dust: Recovers some mana for the target ally.
Ethereal Presence: Increases your maximum mana and takes damage on mana instead of life.
Energy Transfer: Transfers your AP to the target ally.
The Four Seasons: Switches between the four seasons, empowering allies in varied ways.

Sand Weaver

Hailing from origins shrouded in mystery, she roams the endless desert, untouched by thirst or hunger. With a mere gesture, she commands the sands, shaping them to her will with breathtaking speed, be it to shield, strike, or sculpt the dunes as she desires.

Attributes:
Strength: 30 + 3 per Level
Intelligence: 50 + 5 per Level
Dexterity: 40 + 4 per Level

Skills:
Sand Slash: Slashes the target with sand.
Sand Veil: Cloaks an ally with sand, increasing evasion and damaging attackers.
Quicksand: Turns the ground into quicksand, slowing enemies.
Sandstorm: Passively summons a sandstorm to damage enemies; it grows stronger every turn.

Elementalist

While most mages dedicate their lives to mastering a single element or discipline, a rare few possess such brilliance that they wield multiple fields with unparalleled mastery, seamlessly blending their powers.

Attributes:
Strength: 30 + 3 per Level
Intelligence: 60 + 6 per Level
Dexterity: 30 + 3 per Level

Skills:
Incinerate: Burns the target enemy and sets them on fire for several turns.
Elemental Overload: Passively decreases enemies' resistances when dealing damage.
Conductor Rod: Attaches a conductor rod to the target enemy, attracting lightning strikes.
Blizzard: Summons a powerful blizzard to damage enemies every turn.

Add these heroes to your roster today and forge new legends in battle!
